_note: EVE publishes its own class assignment; this file TRANSCRIBES the publisher's scheme. The coding agent did NOT author, choose, or adjust any cut-point (control I3). A domain owner must confirm the scheme is the right operating point for the ancestry-aware context, or supply a different one -- see DEFINITIONS.md sec 1 and docs/DEFINITIONS_QUESTIONNAIRE.md question A11. Sign-off flips status to SIGNED_OFF; until then the producer warns once per run.
_not_applied_here: The provider consumes the publisher's EVE_classes_75_pct_retained_ASM column directly rather than re-deriving a class from the continuous score. The boundaries below are recorded so the rule is auditable and so a domain owner has something concrete to sign off on or override.
source: evemodel.org API (/api/proteins/id/<id>/), column descriptions read from the site's own UI text; retrieved 2026-07-28
source_quote: EVE classification when only classifying the 75% most confident of all possible amino acid substitutions. The 75% set corresponds to the 75% most confident class assignments (over all possible amino acid variants).

published_class_assignment.scheme: 75% most confident class assignments retained; the remaining 25% are labelled Uncertain

observed_class_boundaries._note: OBSERVED from the published data, not published as thresholds and NOT authored here. Recorded because the boundaries proved to be effectively GLOBAL rather than fitted per protein -- verified identical across P53_HUMAN and RASK_HUMAN. If a future release makes them per-protein, this note is how that regression becomes visible.

fields_consumed.eve_class: EVE_classes_75_pct_retained_ASM -- the class the provider consumes
fields_consumed.clinvar: ClinVar_ClinicalSignificance -- shipped BY EVE alongside its prediction; used only for independent corroboration, never to form a call
fields_consumed.gnomad_freq: frequency_gv2 -- gnomAD v2 frequency, shipped by EVE; corroboration only

coverage._note: EVE covers a curated protein set, NOT the proteome. Of the grant strategy's 15 CRC driver genes, 13 are published; FBXW7 and RNF43 are NOT. See decision D-009.

licence._provenance_caveat: The LICENSE.txt served by evemodel.org is copyrighted to the SITE's author, not to the Marks Lab / OATML who produced the predictions. Whether it governs the prediction DATA is therefore unsettled. This repo applies the same no-commit discipline it applies to AlphaMissense: NO EVE score data is committed. The licensing question stays OPEN under decision D3.
